docs/measurements.html.summary: Measurements and interaction 简体中文 There is no standalone measurement creation or saved-ROI restoration API. Noninteractive drawings use drawing layers; editable measurements belong to tool sessions. Built-in and custom tools create the same model-owned measurements through IMeasurementToolContext.CreateMeasurement. Built-in IDs are Point, Length, RectangleRoi and LineProfile. Activate a tool with ActivateMeasurementTool(toolId); each activation creates a session that can create zero or more measurements. Batch markers use DrawingElement descriptions and are managed through DrawingHandle; the two rendering paths have independent purposes. Ownership and geometry IViewerMeasurements.Measurements exposes the entire measurement layer for visibility, input policy and clearing. Clear cancels the current interaction and removes all measurements, while retaining drawing layers and HUD. Tool registration and EndInteraction likewise manage viewer-wide state, not only resources created by the caller. Within a tool session, use the context's Finish to end that activation without affecting a replacement session. Measurement events carry immutable snapshots alongside a live editable/removable handle; subscribing is therefore not a read-only observation capability. MeasurementStyle belongs to .Measurements. Viewer.MeasurementStyle configures newly created measurements independently for each viewer. Assignment copies and freezes all brushes on the caller's thread before UI dispatch. Existing measurements retain their normal and selected colors. MeasurementOptions.Style overrides the viewer default for a new measurement and is snapshotted on creation. Each measurement owns immutable MeasurementGeometry, a framework-generated primary visual and label, an optional pixel query subscription and its registered resources. MeasurementCollection registers measurement owners independently of visuals; a separate visual index resolves hit testing. Each tool session owns its own unfinished measurements. A preview is already an owned measurement; Complete retains it and enables queries. Cancelling creation disposes unfinished measurements. Visuals attach once and are not replaced on completion. Geometry uses source-image coordinates. A rectangle stores normalized opposite corners. Editing updates the model first; MeasurementPresentation projects it to WPF and owns label formatting and the optional plot window. Point and line queries use half-open pixel coverage [0, Width) × [0, Height). Line queries floor clipped endpoints to pixel indices, so fractional coordinates in the last row/column remain sampleable. Input direction and endpoint pixels are retained; lines lying on the exclusive right/bottom boundary are outside the image. Every actual geometry change increments IMeasurement.GeometryVersion and clears results. An equal geometry update is a no-op. Geometry kind cannot change after creation. During a rectangle drag, the opposite corner comes from the drag-start snapshot, so crossing it does not change which corner is fixed. Programmatic updates refresh the primary visual, label and editing control points before public notifications. An external update during dragging replaces the drag baseline; subsequent pointer moves use the same control-point index in that new geometry, preserving its fixed anchor. Labels follow geometry immediately, even when queries are slow or fail. ROI statistics and menu export use the same PixelRegion.Clip conversion of the selected item's geometry. The menu freezes the frame lease and region together; subsequent editing does not change an already captured export request. Editing WPF properties directly is not a supported way to change measurements. Deletion, clear, plot-window closure and viewer closure converge on idempotent item disposal: release specialized resources, then remove the label and primary visual even if a resource fails to close. Removing a visual notifies observers after it is removed, making repeated and reentrant removal harmless. Closing the viewer first stops interaction, cancels queries and disposes items, then clears layers and releases its frames. DisposeAsync waits for in-flight queries to release their own leases, including sources that do not immediately honor cancellation. Interaction The internal MeasurementInteractionCoordinator owns the selected measurement, Idle/Editing/Measuring mode, active measurement tool and session version. The tool registry only stores registrations. MeasurementEditController receives a MeasurementItem directly and owns its MeasurementEditSession and control-point visuals. Hit testing resolves visuals through the collection before selection; unregistered visuals cannot become measurement interaction targets. The session retains drag-start geometry and writes changes through the measurement model; capability checks do not allocate a session. ViewerInputBinding translates WPF input, supplies image scale and applies pointer effects and temporary layer input suppression through IInteractionView without storing interaction state. The coordinator borrows MeasurementLayer for admission and lifecycle notifications. The overlay only performs display, hit testing and selection styling. It holds no coordinator or measurement-owner reference. The coordinator receives translated input and layer lifecycle notifications. MeasurementCollection subscribes to MeasurementLayer content cleanup without exposing the collection to the layer. Clearing first cancels input and selection, then always releases measurement owners and their queries/resources, even if cancellation throws or no coordinator exists. The layer remains in its clearing state throughout both phases. Batch layers independently invalidate their batches. Bulk clearing rejects new measurement/editing sessions and measurement creation from cleanup callbacks; reentrant clears are idempotent, and other layers are still cleared after a failure. Starting a valid measurement ends editing; starting valid editing cancels a measurement. Invalid edit requests do not replace the current session. Escape cancels creation or ends editing; edits already applied are retained. Delete ends the selected editing session before disposing its owner. Clear, hiding the measurement layer, disabling its configured hit testing and viewer shutdown cancel active sessions and release mouse capture. Hiding retains completed items. Losing capture finishes the current drag without deleting the item. The internal mouse-capture boundary can be replaced in tests; capture failure leaves the editing session active without leaving an active drag. Temporary input suppression never changes configured layer hit-testing flags. Restoring input recomputes effective flags for every layer, including layers created while measuring. A hidden measurement layer does not start new tools. During normal operation, a session started synchronously inside a tool callback or completion notification takes precedence, even when it uses the same tool. Returning or throwing from the old callback does not cancel that session or restore its input state. This also applies when cancellation interrupts an outer start request: the callback's session wins. Exceptions from tool callbacks propagate to explicit API callers; framework input and plot-window callbacks log failures and keep the viewer usable. Cleanup restores idle only if that operation still owns the session. When operation and cleanup both fail, an aggregate retains the original failure first and the cleanup failure after it; cleanup still attempts all owned resources. Completion/removal notification subscribers are instead isolated: their exceptions are logged and later subscribers still run. Cancellation ends the outgoing creation context before invoking the tool and then releases that session's unfinished items. Normal completion also ends the context and releases only its unfinished items. Completed items belong to the measurement collection until removal. A callback interrupted by a newer session cannot create through its old context; creation throws ObjectDisposedException. Measurements created by the new session survive cleanup, even when a disposal callback starts it. Cleanup attempts every owned preview and propagates combined session and preview failures to explicit callers. Framework input callbacks log these failures; viewer shutdown includes them in DisposeAsync. Bulk measurement cleanup rejects new measurement creation. Once viewer shutdown begins, ActivateMeasurementTool throws ObjectDisposedException; shutdown cleans both completed and unfinished measurements and waits for owned queries. Query execution PixelQueryScheduler runs one batch at a time. It captures coordinate-sampling and region-statistics requests on the viewer STA, performs all pixel-source operations off STA, and publishes results on STA. Viewer owns this shared imaging service. Measurement items subscribe through MeasurementRuntime, independently of the pixel HUD; disposing a measurement owner does not stop other query clients. Pixel and line coordinates share one gather call; region statistics execute individually so an unsupported region operation does not discard successful pixel results. Query options control rates and result-age limits; query metrics report execution, and each batch owns its frame lease until completion. Pixel and line-profile queries use the same coordinate request protocol; each request's rate category selects the pixel, line or region limit independently of execution and publication. The oldest-due request selects the next group: either one region query or a merged gather of due pixel and line requests. Each group publishes independently before another begins; unselected clients retain their due time and capture fresh state on the next tick. This provides fairness without giving gathers global priority over regions. Geometry invalidation retains the next allowed execution deadline, so continuous dragging cannot bypass the configured query rate. Subscriptions have distinct lifetimes. Publication requires the same registration, stable measurement identity, geometry version and frame descriptor. Re-registering an object never accepts work from its previous subscription. Geometry changes, invalid regions, cancellation and disposal prevent stale publication. Query and publication failures are isolated per subscriber; failed results remain invalid. The pixel HUD alone opts into a moving-result policy: geometry changes retain the last coordinate/value pair, and completed samples can publish within the same interaction session. Session and descriptor changes still reject old work. Its completion-based 10 Hz cap and 300 ms display retention do not alter other tools' rates or geometry validation. See pixel query contracts. The scheduler tracks the source frame ID of published results. A newer frame with the same descriptor does not by itself reject an in-flight result: it may publish within MaxResultAge. This bounded-age policy prevents starvation when video arrives faster than queries finish. Changed descriptors and expired results are rejected. A result from an unchanged frozen frame remains valid without repeated queries. IQueryRuntime supplies monotonic time, ticks, worker execution and UI publication. Deterministic tests manually advance those boundaries without a real window or wall-clock waits. The production runtime uses DispatcherTimer, Stopwatch, Task.Run and Dispatcher publication. Tool registration ownership RegisterMeasurementTool(tool) returns an IDisposable handle for that registration. Dispose it from any thread to revoke only that instance and cancel its active session. Disposal is idempotent and safe after viewer closure; completed measurements survive. The caller owns the tool object, which is never disposed by the registration. Keep the handle for the installing component's lifetime. Ignoring it retains the registration until global unregistration or viewer closure. Registration captures Id and DisplayName once on the Viewer STA. After those external getters return, the viewer checks its lifetime again before accepting the registration. If a getter closes the viewer reentrantly, registration is rejected with ObjectDisposedException and no tool is retained. UnregisterMeasurementTool(id) is a viewer-wide management operation: it removes whichever registration currently has that ID. Component cleanup should instead dispose its own handle, so it cannot remove a replacement registered under the same ID. Revocation takes effect before cancellation callbacks. Callback failures propagate to explicit callers after cleanup; they do not restore the revoked registration. Activation captures the registration instance before interrupting the previous session. Invalid initial requests preserve the current interaction. Reentrant callbacks may supersede a request; the superseded request never activates a same-ID replacement. Built-in menu actions retain the registration captured when the menu opens and ignore it if revoked, hidden, input-disabled or clearing when clicked. Extension boundary Measurement tools use a stable, ordinal Id for programmatic lookup and a separate DisplayName for menus. Registration rejects duplicate IDs; UnregisterMeasurementTool removes only the registry entry and cancels an active session for that ID while leaving completed measurement items intact. Menus are backed by the same registry and are updated for subsequent openings when tools are registered or unregistered. Use viewer.ActivateMeasurementTool(MeasurementToolIds.Length) for built-in tools; the other constants are Point, RectangleRoi and LineProfile. Custom tools implement both Id and DisplayName, and are installed with RegisterMeasurementTool. IDs are case-sensitive; blank IDs or display names are rejected. ActivateMeasurementTool throws KeyNotFoundException for an unknown ID and InvalidOperationException when the measurement layer is hidden or its configured hit testing is disabled. UnregisterMeasurementTool(id) returns whether an entry was removed. Call EndInteraction() to cancel creation or end editing; completed measurements and applied edits remain. Built-in and custom registrations implement IMeasurementTool: Id, DisplayName, and CreateSession(IMeasurementToolContext). Each activation calls the factory on the viewer STA and requires a new IMeasurementToolSession. Store preview handles, first-click coordinates and other mutable interaction state in this session. The registration contains reusable configuration; sharing it across viewers requires a thread-safe factory and configuration. The session receives OnClick(Point), OnMouseMove(Point) and Cancel() callbacks and retains its own creation context. Returning MeasurementClickResult.Finish from OnClick ends input; Continue retains it; call Complete() on each measurement to retain it. Unfinished measurements are released automatically. Normal completion does not call Cancel; interruption calls it once after ending the creation context and releases previews even if cancellation throws. Every returned session is disposed exactly once on the STA, including normal completion, callback failure and factory supersession. Put session-only resource cleanup in Dispose; keep Cancel for cancellation-specific behavior. The creation context ends before either callback. A disposal callback can start a replacement during normal operation; the old session's cleanup cannot end that replacement. Factories may create previews and may reenter viewer APIs. A newer activation takes precedence. If a factory returns after its activation was interrupted, its returned session is cancelled without changing the newer session. A factory failure or null return releases its unfinished measurements; the factory owns cleanup of resources not yet transferred to a measurement. A retained context cannot create measurements after its activation ends. For asynchronous work, call context.Finish() to end only that context's activation after committing the items to retain. It dispatches to the viewer STA and returns false for an ended, superseded or closed context; it never ends a replacement session. IMeasurement.Complete() commits one item and releases its reference to the creation context without finishing the tool session. Each context, item and event snapshot retains Origin with the registration's ToolId and activation's SessionId; multiple items from one activation share the origin, while later activations get a new session ID. Revoking a registration during cancellation invalidates an outer request to start that registration, even when another registration subsequently uses the same ID. Geometry, editing and notifications Create geometry with MeasurementGeometry.Point, Crosshair, Line, Rectangle or Circle. Point and crosshair use Position; lines use Start/End; rectangles normalize opposite corners. Circles use Center and Radius. Factories return the sealed concrete records PointMeasurementGeometry, CrosshairMeasurementGeometry, LineMeasurementGeometry, RectangleMeasurementGeometry and CircleMeasurementGeometry. Pattern-match these types when reading a handle or event snapshot; unsupported coordinate properties do not exist. Kinds use the measurement-specific MeasurementGeometryKind enum. Bounds returns normalized image-space bounds: endpoint bounds for lines and rectangles, diameter bounds for circles, and zero extent for points and crosshairs. Line endpoints retain their original order. Coordinates and extents must be finite; circle radii must be nonnegative. The framework creates the shape, label and supported control points. Coincident control points prioritize extent handles, allowing zero-radius circles, zero-length lines and collapsed rectangles to expand. The entire label uses inverse scale, keeping text, padding and offset fixed in screen space while its anchor follows image coordinates. Use UpdateGeometry for previews and programmatic updates. Directly changing WPF properties is not a measurement mutation API. GeometryChanged reports the new immutable geometry after model, label and result invalidation have been applied. Use it to write edits back to an application model. A multi-shape tool creates multiple measurements, each with its own identity, completion and removal lifetime; there is no arbitrary visual attachment path. Viewer.MeasurementCompleted and MeasurementRemoved cover every tool. Completion fires once, excludes previews and does not imply query readiness. Removal fires only for a previously completed item. Snapshots include Id, complete Geometry and GeometryVersion. The event's Measurement handle supports updates and disposal from any thread; disposal is idempotent and safe after closure. Observing built-in and custom measurements Use Viewer.MeasurementChanged (also on IViewer) to observe completed items without implementing a tool or accessing WPF visuals. Geometry edits, query publication and result invalidation all carry the measurement ID, immutable geometry/version and current immutable QueryResult. QueryResult is null after geometry changes, query failure or expiration. Previews do not emit this event, and an unchanged geometry or already-empty result does not emit it. viewer.MeasurementChanged += (_, e) => { var id = e.Snapshot.Id; var geometry = e.Snapshot.Geometry; var result = e.QueryResult; // Null means the measurement currently has no valid pixel result. // Retain these immutable values or dispatch them to the application's UI. }; viewer.ActivateMeasurementTool(MeasurementToolIds.RectangleRoi); Viewer and handle notifications share one FIFO queue on the viewer STA. Each mutation captures immutable payloads and its subscribers before delivery; reentrant mutations append their events after the current mutation's notifications. Every subscriber sees nondecreasing geometry versions, completion precedes removal, and removal is terminal. The live handle may already reflect a later mutation or disposal while an older snapshot is delivered. Closing from a subscriber preserves queued measurement events and emits Closed after removals. Subscriber exceptions are logged and isolated. The event's Measurement can be disposed from any thread, including reentrantly from a callback. Completion and removal events carry the same result snapshot field, but completion does not promise query readiness. Custom tools may additionally subscribe to IMeasurement.GeometryChanged and QueryResultChanged on their own items. Queries and retained results MeasurementOptions.Query selects a MeasurementQueryKind: Query Supported geometry Result None (default) All Geometry label; no pixel subscription Pixel Point, crosshair Sample and integer source coordinate LineProfile Line Ordered samples and source coordinates RegionStatistics Rectangle Clipped region and channel statistics Incompatible combinations are rejected before any visual attaches. Pixel queries use floor coordinates and reject points outside the frame. Line profiles clip to the frame; ROI queries and export share PixelRegion.Clip. Empty targets have no result. Use MeasurementQueryKind.Pixel, LineProfile, RegionStatistics or None. Set ShowProfileWindow = true independently to request an owned plot window on completion. Closing that window removes the measurement. This option requires a line-profile query. The built-in line-profile tool enables it; explicit queries default to data only. Geometry compatibility and the window/query combination are validated before attachment. LineMeasurementGeometry.Length provides the geometric length in image pixels without reading a frame. A length-only measurement therefore has no query result. Distance calculation avoids intermediate square overflow and underflow; positive infinity is returned only when the resulting length cannot be represented by a double. IMeasurement.QueryResult is null until successful publication. QueryResultChanged provides an immutable MeasurementQueryResult, or null when a previous result becomes invalid. The result includes measurement ID, geometry version, source FrameInfo, query kind and read-only copies of samples, coordinates or channel statistics. It is safe to retain the result after another frame, editing or removal. Collections never borrow scheduler buffers. Results are a closed class family. Pattern-match MeasurementSampleResult to read Coordinates and Samples: Query is Pixel for one pair or LineProfile for ordered pairs. MeasurementRegionStatisticsResult exposes a non-null clipped Region and Channels. Common MeasurementQueryResult properties contain only provenance and Query, so unrelated payload fields cannot be accidentally read. None produces no result. Labels and plots update before notification. Geometry changes invalidate immediately; query failure, descriptor change, missing targets and expiration clear obsolete results. The scheduler and query protocol remain internal. Resources and threads Tool callbacks, context creation and notifications run on the viewer STA. Returned IMeasurement handles dispatch reads, updates and subscription changes to that STA, so background work can update or complete a live preview without retaining a dispatcher. Cancellation still disposes unfinished previews; late updates/completion then throw ObjectDisposedException. The handle supplied by MeasurementEventArgs.Measurement also supports application-driven updates to completed measurements. Dispose and event unsubscription are safe after closure; Id, Origin and IsDisposed remain readable, while other access requires a running viewer. Do not block STA callbacks waiting for workers that call these handles. Use AddResource and OnDispose to bind external resources and event subscriptions to the measurement. AddResource transfers ownership only when it succeeds. If it throws, the call does not change ownership: a new resource remains the caller's responsibility, while re-registering the same instance is rejected and leaves the measurement's existing ownership intact. Do not share an owned resource across measurements. Unregistering a tool retains completed measurements. Selection and deletion target the measurement owner, which removes both its primary visual and label. Setting Measurements.IsVisible = false cancels previews but retains completed items. Viewer.Hide() retains the active tool session and previews; clear and viewer closure dispose all items. Disposal revokes queries, executes cleanup callbacks, disposes resources, closes the plot and removes visuals. Every stage is attempted after failures. Explicit disposal aggregates cleanup errors. Explicit layer clearing and interaction cancellation propagate cleanup errors after attempting all items; framework input callbacks log them. Viewer shutdown includes resource cleanup failures in its shared DisposeAsync result. Disposal is idempotent and does not retry resources whose disposal already ran. Creation is rejected during bulk cleanup and shutdown. Geometry/result and viewer event subscriber failures are logged and isolated. Viewer.FrameCommitted is a viewer-level notification, not a query execution callback. This custom ROI gets the same model editing, statistics, labels and viewer notifications as the built-in ROI: using Fizzy.ImageViewer.Measurements; using System.Windows; public sealed class CustomRoi : IMeasurementTool { public string Id => "custom-roi"; public string DisplayName => "Custom ROI"; public IMeasurementToolSession CreateSession(IMeasurementToolContext context) => new Session(context); private sealed class Session(IMeasurementToolContext context) : IMeasurementToolSession { private IMeasurement? _preview; private Point _start; public MeasurementClickResult OnClick(Point point) { if (_preview is null or { IsDisposed: true }) { _start = point; _preview = context.CreateMeasurement( MeasurementGeometry.Rectangle(point, point), new() { Query = MeasurementQueryKind.RegionStatistics }); return MeasurementClickResult.Continue; } OnMouseMove(point); _preview.Complete(); return MeasurementClickResult.Finish; } public void OnMouseMove(Point point) { if (_preview is { IsDisposed: false }) _preview.UpdateGeometry(MeasurementGeometry.Rectangle(_start, point)); } // The framework releases unfinished measurements after cancellation. public void Cancel() { } public void Dispose() { } } } The scheduler revokes subscriptions but does not dispose subscribers. Measurements own their subscription handles; the pixel HUD is an independent subscriber owned by the viewer. Line-profile rendering The X axis represents sample index and the Y axis pixel value. Both show numeric ticks without axis titles. Horizontal/vertical dashed grids use lighter minor lines. Curves use muted RGB colors and rounded joins without smoothing the samples. Tick spacing adapts to the window size; axis drawings are cached until size, range or DPI changes. The plot uses native WPF drawing with frozen shared pens and cached curve geometry. Unchanged samples retain the geometry; data changes and resizing rebuild it. Within each physical pixel column, rendering retains each finite run's endpoints and minimum/maximum in sample order. Non-finite samples remain gaps; a finite run with only one sample is drawn as a point, including a one-pixel profile. This bounds dense curve detail by display resolution without changing raw measurement samples. Plots consume immutable measurement-result samples directly. Channel buffers grow geometrically and remain owned by the plot; data-only queries do not build RGB curve buffers. Query publication delivers frame identity and read-only spans into the batch result together; callbacks consume them synchronously. WPF geometry serialization and frame queries still allocate when data changes.

docs/menus.html.title: Menus | Fizzy.ImageViewer
docs/menus.html.summary: Menus 简体中文 Implement IMenuItem and retain the disposable from RegisterMenuItem. Viewer borrows the menu object. Disposing registration revokes it without disposing the object; handles support repeated disposal from any thread, even after Viewer closure. Opening and execution Header, IsVisible and checked state are read on the viewer STA for each opening. State-read failure cancels that opening and is logged. ExecuteAsync starts on the STA; return its work rather than launching an unobserved task. Execution exceptions are logged and isolated. The same menu object cannot execute concurrently across openings. WPF Closed may precede Click, so ordinary closure retains bindings until input drains. Reopening or revocation invalidates old bindings. Started work may outlive the menu or Viewer and must own its dependencies. Captured targets Built-in freeze/export actions retain the committed frame, mapping and applicable ROI captured for that opening. Independent leases let accepted work finish after closure; export never switches to a new frame. An old cancel action cannot cancel a replacement measurement activation. Custom asynchronous actions must explicitly choose and own targets. Borrowing Viewer does not promise arbitrary availability after closure. See snapshots and the registration example.

docs/public-api.html.title: Supported public API | Fizzy.ImageViewer
docs/public-api.html.summary: Supported public API 简体中文 Viewer constructs an independent STA window. IViewer is its complete consumer contract, including HudLabelText, QueryOptions and QueryMetrics. Viewer is sealed; application adapters own an instance and use its public API. Raw-window access is not supported. The generated API reference lists public types and members. Source XML defines symbol-level constraints; component guides describe cross-API protocols. Begin with the complete examples. Borrowing viewer capabilities IViewer aggregates the following interfaces and IAsyncDisposable. Viewer implements all capabilities on the same instance; callers can accept the narrow interface they need. Only the owning host disposes the viewer. Borrowed capabilities share its STA, state and shutdown gate and have no independent disposal contract. Interface Namespace Responsibility IFrameSink .Frames Submit owned frames and await commit/drop results ICommittedFrameSource .Frames Acquire current original-frame leases and observe commits IViewerWindow Root Window visibility, placement, title, close policy and Closed IViewerDisplay .Viewport Fit the image to the viewport and configure display range ISnapshotSource .Snapshots Capture independently owned full-frame or region snapshots IViewerDrawing .Drawing Default Markers layer and drawing helpers IViewerMeasurements .Measurements Measurements layer, tools, interaction, style and events IViewerHud .Hud Screen-space text and pixel inspection visibility IViewerMenu .Menus Revocable menu registration IViewerQueries .Imaging Shared query settings and metrics for measurements and HUD using Fizzy.ImageViewer.Frames; static ValueTask<FrameSubmitResult> PublishAsync(IFrameSink sink, ImageFrame frame, CancellationToken ct = default) => sink.SubmitFrameAsync(frame, ct: ct); Submission transfers ownership even when the sink rejects or cancels the frame; alternate implementations and test doubles must release it on every terminal path. Frame readers own their acquired leases. A commit event and a subsequent acquisition are not atomic; use FrameSubmissionOptions.OnCommitted for a specific submission's borrowed lease. Global layer composition belongs only to IViewer.Layers: it can enumerate, create, remove and clear layers across both drawing and measurements. Layers.Items snapshots membership, but its elements remain live mutable handles. IViewerDrawing.Markers and IViewerMeasurements.Measurements expose their respective entire layers; clearing one does not clear the other. A renderer needing a particular layer can accept DrawingLayer; a component updating only an existing drawing can accept DrawingHandle. Layer access includes all content and click handles in that layer, not only the caller's creations. Measurement events include immutable snapshots and a live editable/removable measurement handle. Measurement tool registration and EndInteraction manage the viewer-wide state; a tool session should use its context's Finish to end only itself. Query configuration affects the shared scheduler for measurements and pixel HUD, including other callers. Menu and HUD handles instead operate on their individual registration or text. These interfaces describe normal typed dependencies, not security isolation. The same Viewer implements all capabilities and is the sender of viewer events; casts can recover the complete facade. They do not make drawing independent of WPF. Closed is a window notification; the owner still awaits IViewer.DisposeAsync() for complete shutdown. Threads and window lifetime The optional ILogger<Viewer> constructor argument defaults to no logging. Omitting it or passing null uses NullLogger<Viewer>.Instance; pass a logger to integrate with the application logging system. new Viewer() requires no logging setup. Construction shows the window by default. Pass showWindow: false to create a hidden viewer, configure it and subscribe to events before calling Show(). A hidden viewer has a running STA and can accept frames; its owner must await DisposeAsync() even if it is never shown. Application adapters should register their resources before showing, and dispose the viewer if their own initialization fails. Window methods and properties synchronously dispatch to the viewer STA and throw ObjectDisposedException once disposal begins. Show restores a minimized window, shows it and requests activation. Hide hides without clearing frames, drawings or measurements. Minimize changes window state without hiding it. IsVisible follows WPF visibility (a shown minimized window is still visible); IsMinimized is independent. Minimizing an already hidden window does not implicitly show it. DisposeAsync closes the window and waits for owned background work and the STA to stop. Repeated calls observe one completion task and its fixed success or failure result. Resource cleanup failures are reported after all remaining safe cleanup and STA exit; subscriber notification failures are logged and isolated. Closed subscriptions are released when that terminal notification is delivered. Construction validates window bounds before starting the STA. If initialization fails, safe resource cleanup runs on the owning thread and background work is drained before the original exception is rethrown. If cleanup also fails, an aggregate preserves both initialization and cleanup errors. Resources whose safe detachment cannot be established remain isolated rather than being released or reused. Application adapters route user closure (Closed) and explicit adapter disposal to one idempotent cleanup task, release application resources and await the owned viewer's DisposeAsync. Keep measurement subscriptions until window cleanup finishes when the adapter forwards removal notifications. Closed is a window notification, not a substitute for awaiting disposal. There is no separate public Close method. Event callbacks run on the viewer STA; do not block them waiting for shutdown or for work that needs that dispatcher. Frame submission retains its explicit ownership and terminal-result contract: submission after closure consumes the frame and returns Closed, rather than using the window property exception policy. Drawing and HUD handle disposal is idempotent after closure. See frame contracts and drawing contracts. HudLabelText controls the upper-right HUD text. IsPixelInfoEnabled defaults to true and controls bottom-left pixel inspection and its query subscription; the context menu uses the same state. Both properties can be configured before showing the window. EndInteraction() cancels unfinished creation or ends editing, preserving completed measurements and edits already applied. FitToViewport centers the full image and may choose a scale outside the ordinary wheel range of 0.01–100. At such a scale, the wheel permits steps toward that range and rejects steps farther away, so very large or small images remain navigable. Use await SetDisplayRangeAsync(range) to change the requested grayscale mapping and observe rendering failures. DisplayRange reads that request; snapshots retain the last successfully committed mapping. A newer request or closure cancels an outstanding update. Without a current frame the call configures future submissions and completes immediately. See display contracts. Measurement notifications and extensions See measurements for completion/removal/change ordering, immutable snapshots, geometry/query compatibility and fresh tool sessions. Completion does not promise query readiness. Notifications run on the viewer STA; do not block them. Tool registration lifetime RegisterMeasurementTool returns an IDisposable handle for one registration. Component cleanup disposes that handle; viewer-wide management may instead call UnregisterMeasurementTool(id) to remove the current registration under an ID. Revocation cancels that registration's active session, preserves completed measurements, and never disposes the caller-owned tool. Handles are idempotent and safe across threads and after closure. A retained old handle cannot remove a same-ID replacement. See registration ownership for callback, activation and captured-menu behavior. Internal implementation Built-in measurement tool implementations are internal; use ActivateMeasurementTool(MeasurementToolIds.Point) (or another built-in ID) to activate them. ViewerHost, ViewerWindow, MenuManager, ViewerMenuController, WPF image/overlay/HUD layer controls, control-point visuals, measurement edit sessions, MeasurementItem, scheduling and rendering internals are not public contracts. DrawingElement is a closed family of supported drawing descriptions, not a custom-renderer base class. WPF shape factories and visual metadata are internal. Use drawing descriptions and drawing handles for markers, and measurement models for editable geometry and query results; consumers must not parse WPF visual trees to observe measurement state. The pixel HUD controller, built-in save-menu item and shape metadata/cache are internal. Custom menus use IMenuItem or the action-based menu helpers; custom measurements use CreateMeasurement. Built-in save actions receive snapshot services directly. Menu visibility is determined by IMenuItem.IsVisible, evaluated on each opening. Action-based helpers accept an optional visibility predicate. Use SeparatorMenuItem for separators; the renderer removes leading, repeated and trailing separators. MenuItem and CheckableMenuItem require a nonempty, non-whitespace header and non-null action (and checked-state getter where applicable); constructors reject invalid arguments before registration. Valid headers are preserved as supplied. Built-in interaction actions capture their target when the menu opens. Cancel Measurement only cancels that activation; a replacement activation, including the same tool, is unaffected. Menu registration lifetime RegisterMenuItem(IMenuItem) returns an IDisposable registration handle. Dispose it from any thread to revoke only that registration; disposal is idempotent and safe after viewer closure. Registering the same object twice creates independent registrations. Ignoring the handle keeps the registration alive until the viewer closes. The viewer never disposes the caller-owned menu object itself. Revocation prevents new callbacks from an already open menu and disables its current item; the next opening omits it. An executing action is allowed to finish, including when it revokes itself or the viewer closes. IMenuItem.ExecuteAsync() returns a ValueTask and starts on the viewer STA; no WPF event objects cross this interface. Bindings await completion and log failures. The same menu object cannot execute again while its action is in flight, including after reopening; other actions remain available. Action helpers accept either Action or Func<ValueTask>. Async work that outlives the viewer must own its resources and avoid depending on the viewer dispatcher after it closes. Visibility/check callbacks run on the viewer STA and may change registrations; registrations added while building the menu appear on the next opening. Do not block these callbacks on another thread that is waiting for a viewer operation. Normal menu closure preserves the pending click until input drains. Explicit revocation or viewer shutdown invalidates it immediately. If menu construction fails after freezing a frame, the viewer resumes submissions, removes partial bindings and closes that opening. Header, visibility and check-state failures are logged at the WPF event boundary; they do not escape into the dispatcher. A later opening evaluates registrations again. Viewer shutdown releases registrations, callbacks and WPF menu bindings. using var registration = viewer.RegisterMenuItem( new Fizzy.ImageViewer.Menus.MenuItem("Inspect target", InspectTarget)); // Keep the registration for the lifetime of this feature. Layer capabilities Layers.Markers and CreateDrawingLayer return DrawingLayer, which supports Add(DrawingElement), Add(IEnumerable<DrawingElement>) and DrawingClicked. Both creation overloads and the image-coordinate Viewer.Draw* helpers return DrawingHandle, with symmetric Replace overloads for one element or a collection. Replacement changes the whole content while preserving handle identity and stacking order; shape and element count may change. Click events identify the whole handle through DrawingClickedEventArgs.Drawing. Layers.Measurements returns MeasurementLayer; measurement tools create its content. Both derive from the closed ViewerLayer family, which exposes Name, IsVisible, IsHitTestVisible, ZIndex and Clear. Layers.ClearContents clears content while preserving the layer collection. Layers.Items returns a snapshot of these common layer handles. Built-in layers cannot be removed; the layer base cannot be subclassed by consumers. API baseline tests/Fizzy.ImageViewer.Tests/PublicApi.txt is the reviewed exported API baseline, including types, public/protected members, nullability and default arguments. API tests write PublicApi.actual.txt beside the test assembly. Review intentional differences, update consumers and this contract, then copy that output to the baseline before committing.

docs/releasing.html.title: Release SOP | Fizzy.ImageViewer
docs/releasing.html.summary: Release SOP 简体中文 For maintainers publishing v1.2.0 or later. Older releases are not backfilled. A release is complete only when NuGet payload, immutable /v{version}/r0/ documentation, version index and GitHub Release agree. Never move a published tag or overwrite a retained version. NuGet and Pages are separate services; partial publication is recoverable, not atomic. One-time setup In GitHub Settings → Pages choose GitHub Actions. Set the github-pages environment deployment rules to allow main and release tags; the release job runs on tags. Configure approvals according to repository policy. Configure NuGet Trusted Publishing for owner 0xfizzy, repository Fizzy.ImageViewer, workflow release.yml, and environment github-pages where the policy asks for it. Set repository variable NUGET_USER. No persistent API key is stored. Allow the publishing job contents: write, pages: write, id-token: write. PR validation and audit use read permissions. Protect main, release tags and docs-archive; allow the publishing bot to append archive commits, prohibit force pushes and deletion. Keep the environment's tag policy consistent with the workflow. Create the initially empty archive branch using ./scripts/Initialize-DocumentationArchive.ps1. This explicitly pushes a new branch and must be run by an authorized maintainer. It refuses to replace an existing branch. Review the centralized docs/site.json. For an isolated rehearsal repository, change this configuration and workflow/trust settings there; never send rehearsal packages to the production NuGet ID. Run offline failure gates first. Have another maintainer follow this SOP in the isolated environment, including a deployment failure after package publication. Record commit, workflow run URLs, observed outcomes and unresolved manual checks in a retained release-readiness issue. A local fault fixture is not a real OIDC/Pages exercise. Prepare a release Update the project version, release notes, affected English XML/guides, Chinese translations and examples in one reviewed PR. Versions are SemVer without build metadata; the project version is 1.2.0, its tag and documentation directory are v1.2.0. A prerelease such as 1.3.0-rc.1 does not replace latest stable. npm ci npx playwright install chromium ./scripts/Test-Release.ps1 -Version 1.2.0 node scripts/Test-Browser.mjs ./scripts/Serve-Docs.ps1 Review artifacts/release/validation.json, the transcript, test results, package contents and rendered bilingual pages. Local preparation does not require a tag or a clean checkout and cannot create a publishable bundle. Record interaction checks and required benchmark/consumer validation separately; build success is not physical display, mixed-DPI or device verification. Merge the PR after checks pass. A maintainer explicitly authorizes publication by creating and pushing the tag at the reviewed main commit: git status --short git rev-parse HEAD git tag -a v1.2.0 -m 'release v1.2.0' git push origin v1.2.0 Do not tag until HEAD is the reviewed commit and the checkout is clean. The workflow also checks the project version, tag identity and reachability from origin/main. Automated stages and success criteria Prepare: locked restore, library tests, tool/sample builds, strict docs, fault gates, browser checks and package verification. Pack once; regenerate release API reference from DLL/XML extracted from that exact package. New-ReleaseBundle seals checksums and source identity. Archive: create a draft GitHub Release and upload release-bundle.zip, containing the original nupkg, documentation zip, manifest and validation report. Download and verify before publishing NuGet. Actions artifacts are only temporary transport. NuGet: obtain a short-lived OIDC key, publish or download and verify the existing version. Never use --skip-duplicate. Compare all payload entries except NuGet's added signature. Fixed documentation: restore archived site, merge into docs-archive/v{version}/r0/, commit without force, deploy the entire retained site, and verify every immutable online file. An indexed but incomplete version is not selected as latest. Completion: mark the version complete, update root/latest to the greatest completed stable SemVer, redeploy and verify. Publish the GitHub Release only after success. The final workflow step must print PASS and the fixed documentation URL. Inspect the GitHub Release (not draft), NuGet version, language navigation, API/search and version selector. Preserve original bundle assets permanently. Archive and Pages writes share a concurrency group with development deployment. GitHub may replace pending jobs; a cancelled job is never proof of release completion. The daily/manual audit reports retained tags with missing, draft or inconsistent releases. Recovery Prefer the workflow's manual dispatch from main, selecting the existing tag: gh workflow run release.yml --ref main -f tag=v1.2.0 gh run list --workflow release.yml --limit 5 If a bundle already exists, the workflow downloads it and does not rebuild. Local diagnosis with authorized GitHub read access: ./scripts/Resume-Release.ps1 -Tag v1.2.0 ./scripts/Test-PublishedRelease.ps1 -Bundle artifacts/bundle -RequireCompleted ./scripts/Test-ReleaseStatus.ps1 Resume-Release only restores and verifies; the workflow continues publication and deployment with appropriate permissions. Repeated successful runs leave fixed contents unchanged and do not downgrade latest. Asset identity conflicts always stop. Failure Action and expected result Validation before archive No package was published. Fix source and review a new unused release identity; do not move the old tag automatically. Interrupted archive upload Check whether the single bundle asset exists. If present, recover it; otherwise rerun the original successful preparation artifact. Same-name different content is rejected. NuGet request timeout Query/download first. Matching payload means continue; absent/indexing output stays incomplete and can be retried. Existing NuGet version differs Stop; investigate identity conflict and choose a new version. Never delete or overwrite to force success. NuGet succeeds, Pages fails Keep the draft and original assets; dispatch the same tag. No repack is performed. Online file/identity mismatch Do not mark completion. Inspect archive commit and deployment/CDN state, then retry. Latest/index deployment fails Fixed version remains; same-tag recovery republishes the verified index. GitHub completion response lost Inspect actual draft status, then rerun. Actions artifact expired Recover from durable GitHub Release bundle and archive branch. Original bundle missing after package publication Stop and investigate; do not rebuild a replacement pretending to be the original. Network retries are bounded; indexing or CDN delay ends in a visible failure rather than presumed success. The audit performs no writes. Workflow logs and GitHub Actions failure notifications are the incident entrypoint. For an unrecoverable automation defect in tagged scripts, use a reviewed workflow fix and the retained bundle; do not mutate the tag or archived documentation. Documentation corrections without publishing a package Corrections require a completed release with archived r0; legacy fixed directories are preserved and cannot be converted in place. Prepare requires a clean checkout and creates/switches to a new branch from the active revision source, preserving prior corrections. It proposes the next revision number; use -Branch to choose the new branch name. All changes are checked against the original tag. ./scripts/Revision-Docs.ps1 -Action Prepare -Tag v1.2.0 # On the prepared branch, edit guides/translations, navigation, sample C# or XML; # review translations, accept hashes and commit. No runtime/build/tooling changes. ./scripts/Revision-Docs.ps1 -Action Check -Tag v1.2.0 -Revision 1 git push -u origin docs/v1.2.0-r1 ./scripts/Revision-Docs.ps1 -Action Start -Tag v1.2.0 -Revision 1 -Branch docs/v1.2.0-r1 ./scripts/Revision-Docs.ps1 -Action Status -Tag v1.2.0 ./scripts/Revision-Docs.ps1 -Action Resume -Tag v1.2.0 -Revision 1 ./scripts/Revision-Docs.ps1 -Action Rollback -Tag v1.2.0 -Revision 0 Check requires clean committed source, rejects non-comment runtime changes, and uses the published original DLL with reviewed XML. Samples compile against the original package; strict XML, translation, site and browser checks must pass. The workflow checks allowed changes before executing candidate scripts. Start stores one documentation-rN.zip on the original Release and verifies downloaded bytes before deployment. Same-name content conflicts are checked under the shared deployment lock. Never overwrite assets; choose another revision for different content. The fixed revision is deployed and every file verified before activation. Root/latest only select completed stable versions. Resume downloads the original correction bundle without rebuilding. Rollback verifies the selected completed revision and moves only the active pointer. Re-running an older completed publication cannot reverse a later correction or intentional rollback. Both stages verify online entrypoints; failures remain visible in Actions. Run ./scripts/Test-DocumentationRevision.ps1 for offline immutability, activation, rollback, conflict and source-restriction tests. No correction operation publishes a NuGet package. For development-only preview, initialize the archive once and dispatch docs.yml on main. NuGet credentials and release tags are unnecessary. With no stable version, the homepage links to /dev/.

docs/snapshots.html.title: Snapshots | Fizzy.ImageViewer
docs/snapshots.html.summary: Snapshots 简体中文 CaptureSnapshotAsync captures the committed image, not the newest submission. Whole-frame and region overloads return an independently owned ImageSnapshot; dispose it after use. Capture and save Raw preserves original values and requires TIFF. Display applies the captured committed mapping and supports TIFF, PNG, JPEG and BMP. JPEG composites transparency onto black. Drawings, measurement labels and HUD are not image pixels. using var snapshot = await viewer.CaptureSnapshotAsync(SnapshotKind.Display); await snapshot.SaveAsync(path, SnapshotEncoding.Png); See the complete export example. A region must be nonempty and wholly inside the frame. Missing input or full capacity raises InvalidOperationException. At most two captures are admitted per Viewer, with one export read at a time; capacity rejection happens before lease acquisition. Acceptance synchronously fixes the target, so queueing never selects a newer frame. Ownership, cancellation and failure Accepted capture owns dependencies needed to finish after Viewer closure. The caller owns the result. AcquirePixels() returns a separate lease that may outlive snapshot and Viewer. Its coordinates are region-local; Region and SourceFrame retain original provenance. Cancellation does not prove native work stopped; operations own safe cleanup. Saving takes an independent lease. Operation and cleanup failures are preserved together, and cleanup can fail after destination replacement. Check the file before retrying. Pending or failed display-range changes do not affect captured mapping. See frame contracts and menu targets.

docs/validation.html.title: Validation | Fizzy.ImageViewer
docs/validation.html.summary: Validation 简体中文 Use Windows, PowerShell 7 and the pinned .NET SDK. This repository builds independently; no camera or robot is required. Serialize commands sharing library output. Automated WPF tests use hidden windows and injected boundaries; they do not prove physical display, mixed-DPI, remote-desktop or native GPU behavior. Build and test dotnet restore Fizzy.ImageViewer.csproj --locked-mode dotnet build Fizzy.ImageViewer.csproj -c Release --no-restore dotnet test tests/Fizzy.ImageViewer.Tests/Fizzy.ImageViewer.Tests.csproj -c Release ./scripts/Test-Samples.ps1 Use ./scripts/Test-Release.ps1 for the complete library/tool/sample/documentation/package gate. It does not publish. Documentation maintenance lists prerequisites and browser installation. Inspect the generated package README, XML and immutable version URL before release. Only release-mode validation at a clean matching tag can create a publishable bundle. Pixel queries Run pixel-source, frame metadata, scheduler, HUD and snapshot tests for format, provenance or query changes. Verify independent leases, local region coordinates, immutable results, unsupported capabilities, subscription/geometry invalidation, bounded admission, fairness, cancellation and original-operation plus cleanup failures. TIFF readback tests use a test-only LibTIFF dependency, not the writer itself as the oracle. Measurement ownership and interaction Run measurement/interaction/layer suites for session or lifetime changes. Exercise independent activations, factory reentry and failure, ended contexts, preview cleanup, exactly-once session disposal, notification ordering, programmatic edits, control-point crossing, registration revocation and external leases surviving Viewer closure. Preserve resource/thread safety coverage when removing unsupported recovery behavior. Architectural boundaries Public API tests review exported signatures, nullability and defaults against PublicApi.txt. Review diffs rather than blindly updating the baseline. Public API or behavior changes in the joint workspace also require the consumers' Source builds and relevant tests according to parent rules. XML-only edits do not change signatures or authorize unrelated runtime changes. Startup/shutdown tests must check original errors, safe cleanup after partial composition, shared terminal failure, no repeated destructive disposal, native-resource quarantine and actual STA exit. Menu tests cover Closed-before-Click, reopening, revocation, independent action resources and asynchronous failure. Line-profile allocations Run affected benchmarks for hot-path changes; these synthetic measurements do not establish physical presentation timing or sustained device-stream performance. dotnet run --project tools/FrameBenchmark -c Release -- artifacts/frame-benchmark.json dotnet run --project tools/FrameBenchmark -c Release -- --snapshots artifacts/snapshot-copy-benchmark.json dotnet run --project tools/DrawingBenchmark -c Release dotnet run --project tools/ResizeBenchmark -c Release dotnet run --project tools/LineProfileBenchmark -c Release dotnet run --project tools/LineProfileBenchmark -c Release -- --query-publication Frame/snapshot modes report time and managed allocation, not total process peak memory. Drawing measurements exclude consumer result construction, cross-thread dispatch and physical presentation. Line-profile modes separate data changes, WPF commands, offscreen rendering and query-result copying; immutable result ownership must remain intact. Tool sessions and layer ownership Validate drawing replacement across single/collection/empty content, visual and click identity, invalid replacement retaining content, whole-layer clear, reentrant callbacks and handle invalidation. Verify HUD survives business-layer clear. Tool tests cover cancellation/disposal failures without terminating a replacement session. Geometry and query tests retain half-open pixel coverage, extreme finite coordinates and non-finite sample gaps. Manual checks Run the three examples and record OS, display scale, monitor arrangement and commit. Check first display, wheel zoom, middle-button pan across overlays, tool activation/cancellation, selection/edit/delete, layer visibility, line-profile closure, HUD, menu export and window close while streaming. Repeat across DPI changes and remote desktop where supported. Real GPU attachment, CPU/GPU switching and devices require a separately authorized environment. Report any unperformed scenario explicitly. Inspect rendered English/Chinese guides, search, direct nested API links and version selection at the project prefix. Publication and recovery additionally require the release SOP, fault gates and an isolated service rehearsal. Local tests never authorize a production release.

发布门面和通知；Host 按单次提交回调、公共事件顺序连接，每个订阅边界隔离异常。Host 拥有 STA、窗口、管线、呈现、调度、测量集合、注册表、交互及 HUD。门面先赋 Host 再启动线程，初始化失败走同一幂等关闭流程，各所有者独立尝试安全清理。释放等待实际 STA 退出。 FramePipeline 计入所有已接纳提交直到释放和公开结果完成，包括提交线程上的替换清理。显示范围更新有独立版本结果，新请求/关闭取消等待。共享关闭结果保留资源/排空失败，通知失败隔离。D3D 附加无法证明安全分离时保留呈现器和表面租约至进程结束。 ViewerLifetime 统一停止门和关闭安全的句柄移除调度，HUD 集合拥有视觉并使句柄失效。ViewerInputBinding 把 WPF 来源解析为测量身份和图像坐标，负责效果和临时输入抑制，不保存会话状态。公共视口接收兄弟叠加上的导航和像素查询；ViewportPan 使用屏幕坐标，共享 MouseCaptureSession 保证捕获失败不开始拖动，取消/卸载/关闭结束捕获。 MeasurementInteractionCoordinator 唯一拥有工具、版本、模式、选中及转换策略，直接借用 MeasurementLayer。层可见和命中策略限制工具/编辑启动，重入取消后也检查；临时抑制不改配置。Registry 保存可复用注册，每次工厂生成一次性会话。激活聚合注册身份、创建上下文和会话；旧回调继续前验证身份，Finish 只作用所属上下文。所有预览通过所属上下文创建，结束后拒绝创建，每个会话终止恰好清理一次。 MeasurementCollection 拥有成员、视觉索引、创建策略与 Viewer 样式，Host 显式创建并共享 MeasurementRuntime。Runtime 统一 STA/生命周期调度、查询注册和通知，不依赖视觉容器。集合关闭先停 Runtime 再清对象。通知共用 FIFO，重入追加；内部几何投射同步先完成，公共通知后发。 Layers 容器拥有附加、变换、输入抑制及生命周期，不依赖具体绘图/测量类型；具体层依赖容器。ViewerLayers 组合消费者能力。DrawingLayer 统一单项和集合句柄；MeasurementLayer 通过清内容通知让集合清模型，层不反向拥有集合。清理门覆盖取消与资源释放全过程，finally 清残留视觉，不依赖 coordinator 存在。 MeasurementItem 拥有模型、查询订阅、呈现与释放；完成/释放清上下文引用，Origin 保留不可变来源。先解除查询/视觉，再发移除。Presentation 拥有 WPF、标签及可选曲线，关闭曲线请求删除对象，主动释放先断该回调。终止句柄释放集合/Runtime 引用，终止读只保留稳定数据和轻量生命周期门；绘图失效同样释放层引用。呈现关闭在 STA 清图像源，未知 native 附加独立隔离。 MeasurementQueryDefinition 统一几何/查询组合、构造与 ROI 裁剪，Client 独立缓存请求，每次保留几何版本和坐标。Geometry 是事实，GeometryEditing 定义控制点和拖动；LineProfileWindow 包装可选窗口。没有任意编辑器注册/动态工厂。EditController 拥有会话和控制点，先观察内部几何更新，程序更新重设拖动基线且保留控制点语义。 HUD 独立订阅共享 scheduler。查询协议/运行时是内部 Imaging 能力；一次同步发布同时携带身份和载荷，不分两个暂存通知。测试 Runtime 控制时间、工作和 UI 发布。LineSampling 独立于显示，曲线消费不可变结果并拥有缓冲，纯数据查询不创建曲线或 RGB 中间缓冲。 MenuManager 拥有注册和 WPF 绑定，句柄撤销禁用绑定并释放目标。普通菜单关闭保留绑定至输入排空，以支持 CPU。 批量标记和逐项 WPF 测量服务不同负载，不混淆所有权和交互。 Brush 跨 STA 前复制冻结，每个 Viewer 独立样式，已有视觉保留快照。 普通重入由最新会话接管；批量清理拒绝新会话、重入幂等、失败后继续其余层。 公共扩展暴露稳定消费者能力，不暴露控件/缓存/服务实例；API 基线与调用方及指南一起审查。 查询策略与工具接纳 查询策略独立选择接受旧几何及起始/完成间隔。完成指 Brush 每状态重建 HUD 保留句柄，内容变化时 Update 显示频率与采集/推理独立，可按实测成本选择 30/60 Hz。旧等待结果被覆盖而不积队列；没有新结果不 Replace，新空结果 Replace 空集合。选定最新结果后才创建绘图对象，释放被覆盖结果的池化资源，不在消费者读取时修改结果。 Replace 同步调度到 STA，不限频、不合并、不丢弃；帧管线的最新帧队列不适用于叠加。提交图像和替换叠加并非原子同帧呈现，消费者自行跟踪身份和过期策略。调用 Viewer 时不持生产者锁。 复用 Visual 不等于无分配：集合会复制，冻结 Brush 的不可变元素可共享，可变 Brush 需克隆冻结；WPF 命令、资源和文本仍分配。一次准备内用有界缓存共享相同画笔，不承诺零 GC 或帧率，也不要每帧 GC.Collect。 Clear、移除层和关闭使句柄失效。如果实时运行支持 Clear All Shapes，应与更新循环串行，恢复前重建一次句柄，不逐帧重试失效对象。停止订阅/计时器并等待在途更新再销毁。 持续负载测量每次分配、GC 次数、延迟分位数、预期标记/文本量与缩放。基准的 50 次热身后替换使用两组预建圆，排除结果创建、跨线程及物理呈现，不能证明真实持续流 GC 性能。 坐标、尺寸与输入 OverlayScaleMode 与定位独立，不支持模式在内容变更前拒绝。屏幕尺寸为 WPF DIP，不是物理像素。 线、矩形、圆默认 FixedStroke：几何为图像像素，线宽为 DIP；ScaleWithImage 同时缩放。 圆额外支持 FixedSize，中心为图像坐标，半径/线宽为 DIP。 准星默认 FixedSize，也支持其他两种；ArmLength 为中心至端点距离，中心环半径为其一半。 文本默认 FixedSize，字号/偏移为 DIP，ScaleWithImage 随图像缩放；默认 Segoe UI。 平移只改共享变换，依赖缩放的批次每渲染周期重绘一次，DPI 变化刷新文字。 滚轮、中键平移和像素查询使用公共视口输入面，包括可命中叠加上方。 命中实际填充、轮廓、字形，不是批次边界；空心圆内部和空白透传，重叠时最高启用层最后添加者优先。 DrawingClicked 在 STA 消耗鼠标按下，回调保持短小；订阅错误逐个记录隔离，后续订阅仍接收，事件仍被消费。 测量暂时抑制业务层命中，不改配置标志；结束恢复当前配置，包括期间变更和新增层。 所有权与生命周期 提交复制集合，后续修改不影响绘图。可变 WPF Brush 在所属调用线程复制冻结，不可冻结资源、null 元素、非有限坐标、非正半径/线宽/字号、不支持模式在内容改变前失败。Replace 验证并录制后发布，录制失败保留旧图。所有视觉操作调度 STA；Dispose 同步幂等，失效后 Replace 抛 ObjectDisposedException。 内置层不可移除，名称非空且区分大小写唯一，层不可跨 Viewer 传递。Items 是成员快照但其中句柄仍可变。Clear 保留设置和订阅，移除/关闭释放资源及订阅；新增点击订阅拒绝失效层或关闭 Viewer，退订关闭后仍安全。 IViewer.Layers 允许全局管理；IViewerDrawing 只暴露默认 Markers，测量能力暴露整层。整层句柄能清除他人内容，组件只需更新一项时传 DrawingHandle；需要创建或全局清理后重建时才保留层。 可编辑测量通过工具上下文创建、更新几何并 Complete，拥有框架视觉、标签、查询及注册资源。不支持附加任意 WPF 元素，内部 shape factory/MeasurementOverlay 不是公共接口。 ClearContents/Clear All Shapes 取消测量并清全部业务层，保留 HUD。先取得层快照，回调新建层存续，已被移除层跳过，其余按顺序清理。清测量层也取消创建/编辑。显式清理尝试所有安全步骤并传播聚合错误，菜单/输入记录错误，关闭错误进入 DisposeAsync。快照只导出图像，不导出叠加。 HUD 文字 HudLabelText 控制右上标签，null/空值隐藏且读回空字符串。IsPixelInfoEnabled 独立控制像素 HUD，可显示前设置。HudTextHandle/AnchorAlignment 属于 Hud。 DrawHudText 返回可更新文字/颜色的句柄；位置、对齐和 double 字号在其生命周期固定，改变布局需新建。创建/更新在调用线程复制 Brush 并调度 STA。null 文字/Brush、不可冻结 Brush、非法锚点/对齐、非正或非有限字号拒绝。释放幂等，关闭使句柄失效，之后 Update 抛 ObjectDisposedException。清业务层不清 HUD。 验证 dotnet test tests/Fizzy.ImageViewer.Tests dotnet run -c Release --project tools/DrawingBenchmark 基准覆盖 1,000/10,000 圆的创建、替换、含布局的缩放重绘，与逐 Shape 路径比较；时间依机器且不含 GPU 呈现，Visual 数与功能行为是自动验收依据。

docs/zh-CN/frame-pipeline.html.title: 帧管线 | Fizzy.ImageViewer
docs/zh-CN/frame-pipeline.html.summary: 帧管线 English 输入与生命周期 ImageFrame.Copy 同步复制，原存储仍属调用方。TakeOwnership 接管不可变存储，最后一个帧或租约释放时恰好执行一次 release，包括构造验证失败；构造和清理均失败时聚合，原错误在前，不重试 release。宽高为正，正 stride 至少覆盖有效行；支持行填充，输入单平面、从上到下，Gray16/Gray32Float 为小端。不支持的格式明确失败。 存储字节数不等于语义通道数：Gray16 两字节一个通道，Bgr32 四字节三个通道，末字节为填充；Bgra32/Pbgra32 四通道，分别为直接/预乘 alpha。 SubmitFrameAsync 在取消、冻结和关闭时也消耗帧。禁止重复提交、修改或释放已转移存储。每个 FrameLease 独立持有引用，幂等释放；启动异步工作前获取独立租约，不得一边读取内存一边释放同一租约。 提交自身释放错误进入 FrameSubmitResult.Error；Viewer 当前帧或重绘租约的释放错误进入 DisposeAsync；独立租约释放错误直接传播。release 在最后释放引用的线程同步执行，可能是提交线程、工作线程或 STA，生产者负责线程亲和并保持短小，不存在专用释放线程。 Viewer 保留原帧供查询，冻结可能无限期保留；相机池必须允许这种保留，或适配器主动复制。只读接口不能阻止其他持有者修改内存，不可变性是生产者契约。 提交与显示 每个 Viewer 一个 STA 和渲染循环，最多一帧处理中、一帧等待，新帧替换等待帧。状态为 Committed、Superseded、Frozen、Cancelled、Closed、Failed；同时检查 Status 和 Error，丢帧也可能有清理错误，清理失败不改变提交或丢弃原因。 取消在 UI 提交前尽力生效，提交后不撤销。等待帧在出队、替换、冻结或关闭时结束，不为每帧注册取消回调。Committed 表示 UI 已更换源和当前帧，不证明显示器已呈现。FrameId 在 Viewer 内单调递增。写像素后先执行单次 OnCommitted，再发 FrameCommitted；回调中的租约仅借用至回调结束。查询通知独立调度，禁止回调阻塞等待另一提交；异步工作自行获取租约。订阅异常隔离。 CPU 呈现器复用两个 WriteableBitmap，后台转换，先写未显示位图再切换。WPF 原生八位布局保留，映射灰度和显示快照使用 Pbgra32。GPU 使用 D3DImage。图像坐标始终是原图像素，不随 DPI 改变。 DisplayRange 读取最新请求；等待 SetDisplayRangeAsync 观察重绘失败。默认 Gray8 0–255、Gray16 0–65535、Gray32Float 0–1。边界有限且严格递增，范围外裁剪，NaN/负无穷黑、正无穷白。存在帧时等该显示版本成功提交；新请求或关闭取消旧等待，无帧时只配置后续提交。当前 GPU 帧拒绝非空范围，拒绝前不改请求。禁止 STA 同步等待。 第一帧正在准备时仍可能提交其之前捕获的映射，需要重绘时先等待第一帧。失败更新的请求值仍可读，重试需显式再次设置。快照使用最后成功提交的映射与版本。 像素访问与测量 像素协议、CPU 解码、坐标区域、结果及租约属于 Frames；Imaging 负责显示转换、采样和调度，Frames 不依赖 Imaging。AcquireCurrentFrame() 返回调用方拥有的租约。TryGetCpuPixels 只访问已有 CPU 内存，GPU 返回 false，没有通用 Data 属性。CpuFramePixelReader 越界返回 false，范围内 GPU 读取抛出 NotSupportedException，不隐式下载。 跨后端使用租约的 ReadPixelsAsync、ComputeRegionStatisticsAsync、ReadRegionAsync。输入坐标用 ReadOnlyMemory，结果保留顺序、原单位和格式；每次异步调用自行获取租约直至结束。CPU 可在调用线程同步完成，直接调用不承诺工作线程；Viewer 调度器及快照自行安排离开 STA。 操作和清理错误一起保留，原错误优先；区域结果仅在源租约清理成功后交给调用方，否则释放不可交付区域。PixelSamplesResult 和 RegionStatistics 复制输入并暴露只读集合，提供者返回数组后不得修改或复用。结果携带查询租约自己的 FrameInfo；未提交或派生图像 FrameId 为 0，无源时间戳，提交前获取的租约仍未提交。 RegionPixels/ImageSnapshot 的 SourceFrame、Region 描述原输入。AcquirePixels 返回描述裁剪或转换后像素的独立租约，使用局部坐标，不冒充源帧身份。RegionPixels 自有 CPU 图像需释放，仅由经过验证的区域读取创建。不支持能力明确失败，无下载回退。 CPU 支持 Gray8/Gray16/Gray32Float/Rgb24/Bgr24/Bgr32/Bgra32/Pbgra32。统计按语义 Gray、R/G/B[/A] 顺序返回 count/min/max/mean，忽略非有限浮点，无有限值时 count 为 0、统计为 null；预乘值仍预乘，Bgr32 填充不参与。格式和通道数必须匹配，显示范围不限制原始查询值。 一个调度器同一时刻一批：STA 捕获几何，后台查询，STA 发布。最早到期请求决定下一批是单个 ROI 或合并点/线采样；未选中者不持租约，下次捕获新状态。几何变化保留节流截止时间。 点和线使用半开覆盖 [0, Width) × [0, Height)；线裁剪后端点 floor，Bresenham 保留输入方向及端点像素。右/下独占边缘上的线无样本；交叉端点可夹到最后像素。极大有限坐标使用精确裁剪，但不能恢复调用前丢失的精度。ROI floor 左上、ceil 右下再与图像相交，空区域不查询。 QueryOptions 默认 Pixel/Line 30 Hz、Region 10 Hz、MaxResultAge 100 ms，均为正，频率需可表示至少一个 TimeSpan tick 且小于最大间隔。年龄从帧/几何捕获计时，不是相机采集时间。订阅、会话、描述符及测量几何版本检查始终存在；新帧可接受年龄范围内旧帧结果，暂停且未变帧结果不因时间自动过期。 QueryMetrics.Batches 计完成批次含失败，不等于发布数；ExpiredResults 计发布时超龄结果，不计后来清空的显示值；LastDurationMilliseconds 从捕获到后端完成，含工作调度、不含 STA 发布等待。 像素 HUD 限频为 min(10, PixelQueryRateHz)，每次完成（含失败）后完整等待间隔。移动合并最新目标但不重置间隔，同会话可发布之前采样位置，坐标和值一起更新。目标或帧变化时旧显示最多保留采样开始后 300 ms，之后显示 —；静止结果不过期，失败立即 —。离开图像、禁用或无帧时隐藏并拒绝旧结果。 HUD 无背景，固定文化数字格式，每值至少七字符，长值不截断，窄视口裁剪不换行。每次捕获用当前容器指针和变换重算坐标，即使无鼠标移动；隐藏/卸载或容器外无目标。FrameId 不作为 HUD 标签。 冻结、快照与保存 菜单打开冻结当前帧，清等待帧并使冻结前在途提交失效；关闭后恢复新输入。菜单租约跨 Click/Closed 次序保留帧和显示设置；保存弹窗前获取独立租约。输入排空或 Viewer 关闭释放菜单租约。 快照调用时固定帧，Raw 保留原值，Display 应用已提交映射，不含叠加、HUD 或视口缩放。整帧也显式请求完整区域，GPU 读取不缓存回源。一次读、一次等待，更多请求在获取租约前同步拒绝；完成、取消、失败释放容量。ROI 同时固定帧与整数区域。 Raw 接管独立 CPU 区域，不额外复制；最后像素引用才触发区域 release，包括越过快照的独立租约。交付前其他清理失败会清理候选快照并保留全部错误。 保存先在目标目录写临时文件，编码成功后替换。替换前及 TIFF 行间检查取消，WPF PNG/JPEG/BMP 编码本身不可中断。Display 支持四种格式，JPEG 黑底；Raw 仅 TIFF，不默默降精度。清理错误可能发生在替换成功之后。菜单整图和选中已完成矩形区域都可保存，菜单一次一个保存，独立快照可并发保存且关闭后仍可用。 TIFF 为无压缩 Classic TIFF，Gray16 UINT、Gray32Float IEEEFP、左上方向、RGB 顺序、正确 alpha 标签，不写 Bgr32 填充；超保守尺寸限制拒绝，不支持 BigTIFF。参见快照指南。 关闭与集成 使用 await using 或等待 DisposeAsync，不能阻塞 STA。关闭停止接纳，排空已接纳提交、渲染和查询至公开结果完成并等待线程退出，包括提交线程上的替换清理。重复等待同一结果；清理失败不变为成功，不重做。Viewer 不等外部独立租约，也不提前回收其存储；已接纳且独立持依赖的导出可继续。 GPU 表面与显式像素查询 GPU 输入提供不可变 BGRA IDirect3DSurface9、所有者及显式像素源。呈现不触发像素读取，CPU 显示范围不应用于 GPU。查询仅下载明确请求数据，返回独立 CPU 存储；提供者支持协议要求的并发、格式与所有权。最后源租约释放才清理查询资源；不能证明 D3D 安全分离时隔离保留而不重用。真实 GPU/切换仍需设备验证。 内部组成 FramePipeline 管等待帧、当前帧、冻结代次、请求/已提交显示设置及结果；FramePresentation 管后台准备、STA 呈现和后端资源；MenuSnapshotSession 管菜单目标与保存互斥；SnapshotCapture 管串行区域读取和独立快照。 CommittedViewLease 原子捕获帧租约、显示范围和版本，不拥有导出同步。管线共享 ViewerLifetime 接纳门，昂贵上传在门外，附加图像和发布当前帧在门内；提交、冻结/恢复和呈现释放由 STA 串行。仅图像提交发帧通知，纯重绘不发。关闭先停管线和交互、释放菜单、测量与层，再等待渲染、查询及 STA。

docs/zh-CN/getting-started.html.summary: 入门 English 使用 Windows、.NET 8、net8.0-windows 项目并设置 UseWPF=true。Viewer 创建独立 STA；控制台程序无需自行创建应用 Dispatcher 即可调用门面。 使用 Viewer(showWindow: false)，保证所有退出路径执行异步释放。 在 Show() 前订阅 Closed 并配置窗口。 用 ImageFrame.Copy 创建不可变输入，只提交一次；即使 Viewer 已关闭，提交也转移所有权。 等待提交或丢弃结果，再显示窗口。 关闭时停止生产者，等待其结束及 DisposeAsync；不要在 STA 回调中同步等待。 Closed 是通知，不证明渲染和查询已排空。Viewer 对应一次窗口生命周期，关闭后应新建实例。 完整示例 在仓库根目录执行；这些人工检查会打开 WPF 窗口： dotnet run --project samples/BasicViewer dotnet run --project samples/LiveOverlays dotnet run --project samples/MeasurementsAndExport BasicViewer：显示复制的灰度像素并等待关闭。 LiveOverlays：模拟帧流、复用批量句柄、先结束生产再释放。 MeasurementsAndExport：独立点测量会话、通知和 artifacts/samples/ 下的 PNG 输出。 ./scripts/Test-Samples.ps1 只构建、不打开窗口。导出可接受输出目录参数，选择不含需保留的 snapshot.png 的目录。 继续阅读帧、生命周期和测量。

docs/zh-CN/measurements.html.title: 测量与交互 | Fizzy.ImageViewer
docs/zh-CN/measurements.html.summary: 测量与交互 English 没有独立创建测量或恢复保存 ROI 的 API。非交互内容用绘图层，可编辑测量属于工具会话。内置 Point、Length、RectangleRoi、LineProfile 与自定义工具都通过 IMeasurementToolContext.CreateMeasurement 创建模型；每次激活创建可产生零到多个测量的独立会话。 所有权与几何 Measurements 暴露整层可见性、输入和清理。清层取消交互并删除测量，保留绘图/HUD。注册和 EndInteraction 是 Viewer 全局操作；会话内部用 context.Finish，避免影响替代会话。事件携带可编辑/删除的实时句柄，因此订阅并非纯只读能力。 MeasurementStyle 配置每个 Viewer 的未来测量，调用线程复制冻结 Brush，已有测量保留正常/选中色；Options.Style 覆盖新项默认并在创建时快照。测量拥有不可变几何、主视觉、标签、可选查询及资源；集合独立登记模型和视觉索引。预览也是已拥有对象，Complete 保留并启用查询，取消释放未完成项，完成不重建 Visual。 几何使用原图坐标，矩形标准化角点；编辑先更新模型，Presentation 再投射 WPF/标签/曲线。真实变化增加 GeometryVersion 并清结果，相等更新无操作，不可改变几何种类。点/线使用半开像素覆盖，线裁剪、floor，保留输入方向和端点；右下独占边缘在图像外。 矩形拖动保留拖动开始的对角锚点，越过不改变固定角；程序更新在通知前刷新视觉、标签和控制点，拖动期间外部更新替换基线并沿用控制点索引。标签立即跟随，不等查询。 ROI 统计和菜单导出共用 PixelRegion.Clip；菜单同时固定帧和区域，后续编辑不改变已捕获导出。不支持直接改 WPF 属性来改测量。 删除、清空、曲线窗口关闭、Viewer 关闭汇入幂等释放，即使专用资源失败也尝试去掉标签和主视觉，移除后才通知。关闭先停交互和查询、释放测量，再清层和帧；DisposeAsync 等待在途查询及其租约，即使后端不立即响应取消。 交互 内部 coordinator 唯一拥有选中项、Idle/Editing/Measuring、工具和会话版本；registry 只存注册。编辑控制器拥有编辑会话和控制点，输入适配器翻译事件及视口效果，不复制交互状态；未登记视觉不能成为测量目标。测量集合独立订阅层清理，取消失败或缺少 coordinator 仍清模型、查询和资源。整个批量清理期间拒绝创建/新交互，重入 clear 幂等，失败后继续其他层。 有效测量启动结束编辑，有效编辑取消测量，无效请求保留当前会话。Escape 取消创建或结束编辑，保留已应用修改；Delete 先结束编辑再释放对象。清空、隐藏测量层、禁用其配置命中、关闭 Viewer 都取消会话并释放捕获；隐藏保留完成项。丢失捕获结束拖动不删项，捕获失败保留编辑但没有活动拖动。 临时抑制不改配置标志，恢复时按当前配置重算，包括新层。隐藏测量层不能启动工具。普通操作中回调同步创建的新会话优先，旧回调返回/抛错不取消替代会话。同样适用于取消打断外层启动。 显式 API 传播工具错误；框架输入及曲线窗口回调记录错误。操作和清理失败聚合、原错误在前，并尝试全部资源。通知订阅错误逐个隔离。取消或正常完成先结束上下文，再执行回调及清未完成项；结束上下文不能创建，抛 ObjectDisposedException。旧清理不删除新会话项目。关闭开始后激活抛 ObjectDisposedException，清理所有完成/预览并等待查询。 查询执行 一个共享 scheduler，一次一批，STA 捕获、后台读像素、STA 发布。最早到期请求选一个 ROI 或合并所有到期点/线 gather；各批独立发布，未选者保留到期时间下次捕获新状态。几何变化不绕过限频。每批拥有帧租约，释放某测量不停止其他订阅。 发布检查同注册、测量身份、几何版本和描述符；重新订阅不接受旧工作。几何变化、非法区域、取消/释放阻止过期发布；失败按订阅隔离，结果无效。同描述符的新帧不必拒绝在途结果，允许 MaxResultAge 范围内发布避免高速视频饥饿；描述符变化或超龄拒绝，未变冻结帧结果继续有效。 仅像素 HUD 使用移动结果策略，同会话保留整组坐标/值，完成后限 10 Hz、旧显示保留 300 ms，不改变测量规则。测试用 IQueryRuntime 手动推进时钟、工作和发布；生产用 DispatcherTimer、Stopwatch、Task.Run 与 Dispatcher。 工具注册所有权 RegisterMeasurementTool 返回只撤销该注册实例的句柄，可任意线程幂等释放，关闭后安全，完成项存续；工具对象仍由调用方拥有。Id/DisplayName 在 STA 读取一次，getter 重入关闭后重新检查生命周期，拒绝且不保留工具。 UnregisterMeasurementTool(id) 移除当前同 ID 注册；组件清理应释放自己的句柄，以免删除替代注册。先撤销再取消回调，失败不恢复注册。激活在打断旧会话前固定注册实例，无效初始请求保留交互；重入替换后不能误激活同名新注册。菜单捕获注册实例，点击时被撤销、隐藏、禁用或清理则忽略。 扩展边界 Id 区分大小写、非空，DisplayName 非空，重复 ID 拒绝；未知 ID 激活抛 KeyNotFoundException，隐藏或禁用层抛 InvalidOperationException。注册变化反映到后续菜单打开。EndInteraction 保留已完成项和应用编辑。 CreateSession 在 STA 每次返回新 IMeasurementToolSession，预览、首击坐标等可变状态放会话，注册只保留可复用配置。跨 Viewer 共享注册需线程安全工厂/配置。OnClick 返回 Continue 或 Finish；只有显式 Complete 的测量保留。正常完成不调用 Cancel，中断在上下文结束后调用一次；每个返回会话在 STA 恰好 Dispose 一次，包括失败、工厂被替代。 工厂可创建预览和重入；返回时激活已结束的会话会取消但不改变新会话。工厂失败或 null 返回清未完成项，未转移资源由工厂清理。异步工作可 context.Finish，只结束自身激活，旧/关闭上下文返回 false。Complete 只完成一项并释放上下文引用，不结束工具。Origin 保留 ToolId/SessionId，同次多项共享，会话间不同。 几何、编辑与通知 通过 MeasurementGeometry.Point/Crosshair/Line/Rectangle/Circle 创建封闭不可变记录，用具体类型模式匹配。点/准星 Position，线 Start/End 保序，矩形标准化对角，圆 Center/Radius；Bounds 分别为点零范围、端点范围或直径框。坐标和 extent 有限，半径非负。 框架生成主图形、标签和控制点；重合点优先 extent 控制点，因此零圆/零线/塌缩矩形可展开。标签文字、padding、偏移固定屏幕尺寸，锚点跟图像。用 UpdateGeometry；几何通知发生在模型、标签和结果失效之后。多形工具创建多个独立身份/生命周期的测量，不提供任意视觉附加。 Completed 每项一次且排除预览，不代表像素结果就绪。Removed 仅对之前完成项发出，快照含 ID、完整几何和版本；实时句柄可从任意线程更新或释放，关闭后释放安全。 观察内置与自定义测量 MeasurementChanged 覆盖完成项的编辑、查询发布和失效，携带不可变 Snapshot/QueryResult；几何变化、失败或过期时结果 null。预览、相等几何或已空结果不发无意义事件。 Viewer 和句柄共用 STA FIFO 通知队列，每次变化捕获载荷及订阅者，重入事件追加；几何版本不倒退，完成先于删除，删除为终止。较旧快照到达时实时句柄可能已变或释放。回调关闭仍交付排队事件，Closed 晚于删除；订阅异常隔离。可额外订阅 GeometryChanged/QueryResultChanged。 查询与保留结果 Query 几何 结果 None（默认） 全部 几何标签，无像素订阅 Pixel 点/准星 一个样本和整数源坐标 LineProfile 线 按顺序样本和坐标 RegionStatistics 矩形 裁剪区域和通道统计 非法组合在附加前拒绝，空目标无结果。点 floor，线裁剪，ROI/导出共用 Clip。ShowProfileWindow 独立请求完成时创建曲线窗，只允许线剖面查询；内置启用，显式查询默认仅数据，关闭曲线删除测量。 LineMeasurementGeometry.Length 不读帧，稳健距离避免中间平方溢出/下溢，仅不可表示最终长度时正无穷。纯长度测量没有 QueryResult。 结果含测量 ID、几何版本、FrameInfo、查询种类以及只读样本/坐标/统计副本，不借 scheduler 缓冲，可跨帧、编辑、删除保留。模式匹配 MeasurementSampleResult 或 MeasurementRegionStatisticsResult；公共基类只放来源和 Query，None 无结果。标签和曲线先于通知更新，几何立即失效，查询失败/描述符变化/无目标/超龄清旧结果。 资源与线程 工具回调、上下文创建和通知在 STA；IMeasurement 的读取、更新、订阅会自行调度，后台可更新/完成仍存活预览。取消后晚到调用抛 ObjectDisposedException。关闭后 Dispose/退订安全，Id/Origin/IsDisposed 可读，其余需要运行 Viewer。不要 STA 等待会调用句柄的工作线程。 AddResource 成功才转移所有权；失败不改变原所有权，重复同实例拒绝但既有所有权仍在。不得跨测量共享被拥有资源。OnDispose 绑定外部清理。撤销注册保留完成项；隐藏 Measurements 取消预览但保留完成项，Viewer.Hide 保留活动会话和预览；清空/关闭删除全部。 释放撤销查询、执行回调、清资源、关曲线、移视觉，每一步失败后仍尝试其他安全步骤。显式释放/清理传播聚合错误，框架输入日志隔离，关闭错误汇入共享 DisposeAsync；幂等不重试已执行清理。scheduler 撤销订阅但不释放订阅者，测量和 HUD 分别拥有自己的订阅。完整工具代码见示例。 线剖面渲染 X 为样本索引、Y 为像素值，仅数字刻度，主次虚线网格；曲线为柔和 RGB、圆角连接，不平滑样本。刻度随窗口尺寸，轴缓存至尺寸/范围/DPI 变化。WPF 使用冻结笔和缓存几何，数据不变保留，变化/缩放重建。 每物理像素列按样本顺序保留有限段端点及 min/max，非有限值保留断点，单样本画点；仅限制显示细节，不改变原始数据。曲线直接消费不可变结果，通道缓冲几何增长且归窗口；纯数据查询不建 RGB 曲线缓冲。发布同时提供帧身份和批次数据，只同步消费；数据变化时 WPF 序列化和帧查询仍分配。

docs/zh-CN/menus.html.title: 菜单 | Fizzy.ImageViewer
docs/zh-CN/menus.html.summary: 菜单 English 实现 IMenuItem，保留 RegisterMenuItem 返回的释放句柄。Viewer 借用菜单对象；释放注册只撤销注册，不释放对象。句柄支持任意线程重复释放，包括 Viewer 关闭后。 打开与执行 每次打开时在 STA 读取 Header、IsVisible 和勾选状态。读取失败取消此次打开并记录日志。ExecuteAsync 在 STA 开始，应返回实际工作，不启动无人观察的任务。执行异常被记录并隔离，同一菜单对象不能跨多次打开并发执行。 WPF Closed 可能早于 Click，因此普通关闭保留绑定直到输入排空。重新打开或撤销注册会使旧绑定失效。已开始工作可越过菜单和 Viewer 生命周期，必须自行拥有依赖。 固定目标 内置冻结和导出保留该次打开时捕获的已提交帧、映射和适用 ROI。独立租约允许已接纳工作在关闭后结束，导出不会改用新帧。旧取消动作不能取消替代的测量会话。 自定义异步动作必须明确选择并拥有目标。借用 Viewer 不意味着关闭后仍可任意调用。参见快照和注册示例。

docs/zh-CN/public-api.html.title: 公共 API 与 Viewer 生命周期 | Fizzy.ImageViewer
docs/zh-CN/public-api.html.summary: 公共 API 与 Viewer 生命周期 English Viewer 创建独立 STA 窗口，IViewer 是完整消费者契约；Viewer 为 sealed，应用适配器通过组合拥有它，不访问原始窗口。生成式 API 参考列出类型和成员，XML 定义符号契约，组件指南定义协作协议。 借用能力接口 拥有窗口生命周期的组件使用 IViewer 并等待异步释放。只使用部分能力的组件借用帧输入、已提交帧读取、窗口、显示、绘制、HUD、测量、菜单、查询或快照接口。接口由同一个 Viewer 实现，并不建立独立生命周期或安全隔离。 全局图层管理只在 IViewer.Layers 上。绘制接口只暴露默认 Markers，测量接口暴露 Measurements。图层句柄允许管理整层，包括清空他人内容；只需更新单项时传递单项句柄。使用能力接口不会让调用方获得私有实现、线程或调度器所有权。 线程与窗口生命周期 showWindow: false 支持显示前配置、订阅和提交。Show 显示、恢复最小化并请求激活；Hide 隐藏但保留内容；Minimize 不隐式显示已隐藏窗口。已显示但最小化的窗口仍为可见，最小化状态独立查询。普通属性和窗口操作在关闭开始后抛出 ObjectDisposedException。 Viewer 只对应一次窗口生命周期，关闭后不能重新打开。无论是否显示过，都需 await DisposeAsync()；它关闭窗口并排空已接纳工作，等待真实 STA 退出。重复调用观察同一成功或失败结果，不重复破坏性清理。安全清理后传播资源清理错误，通知订阅者错误被日志隔离；不能证明安全分离的 native 资源继续隔离保留。 构造前验证窗口边界。初始化失败在所属线程清理并排空后台工作，重新抛出原始异常；清理同时失败时保留两个错误。应用适配器将用户关闭和显式释放汇入一个幂等清理流程；如果转发测量删除通知，保留订阅直到清理结束。 Closed 只是窗口通知，不能替代等待释放。回调在 Viewer STA，不得同步等待关闭或其他依赖该 Dispatcher 的工作。关闭后的帧提交仍消耗帧并返回 Closed；绘图和 HUD 句柄关闭后仍可幂等释放。 HudLabelText 控制右上标签，IsPixelInfoEnabled 默认开启，控制左下像素查询。EndInteraction() 结束创建或编辑，保留已完成测量和已应用编辑。 FitToViewport 可产生超出普通滚轮 0.01–100 范围的缩放；此时滚轮只允许朝该范围方向变化。使用 SetDisplayRangeAsync 观察重绘失败。属性读取最新请求，快照使用最后成功提交的映射；较新请求或关闭取消等待中的更新。无帧时只配置后续输入，立即完成。详见帧。 测量通知与扩展 只对完成项发出完成、变更和删除通知，预览不发出。快照不可变并含 ID、几何、来源及版本，实时句柄可能已反映后续变化；回调在 STA，订阅者失败被隔离。完成不代表查询结果就绪。重入通知排队保持顺序，删除后不再变更，Closed 晚于删除通知。 工具每次激活创建独立会话；通过上下文创建预览，Complete 保留结果，Finish 只结束所属激活。查询种类和几何组合在附加前验证；曲线窗口只能配合线剖面查询，数据查询可不建窗口。详细协议见测量。 工具注册生命周期 注册句柄仅撤销其所属注册实例，不删除已完成测量。ID 撤销作用于当前同名注册。注册元数据在 STA 读取一次；关闭和替换使旧句柄失效。替换、重入和清理规则见工具所有权。 内部实现 内部 Host、渲染、查询调度器、测量显示层和 WPF 控件不构成公共扩展接口。测试可观察内部对象，但消费者应依赖公开门面、句柄、几何及工具会话。详见架构。 菜单注册生命周期 注册返回独立释放句柄，菜单对象仍归调用方。撤销使旧绑定失效；已经开始的异步动作可在关闭后继续，必须自行拥有依赖。菜单状态和动作启动发生在 STA，异步执行失败被记录隔离。完整规则见菜单。 图层能力 Markers 和自定义绘图层支持单元素或集合 Add，返回支持相同两种 Replace 的 DrawingHandle；替换整个内容，不改变身份和叠放顺序。点击标识整项绘图。测量层由工具创建模型内容，没有批量绘图接口。 两种层共享名称、可见、命中测试、ZIndex、Clear。Items 返回成员快照，ClearContents 保留图层；内置层不可移除，消费者不可派生层基类。 API 基线 tests/Fizzy.ImageViewer.Tests/PublicApi.txt 记录导出类型、成员、可空性及默认值。测试输出 PublicApi.actual.txt；先审查差异并更新调用方、XML 和指南，再接受基线，不能以更新基线代替契约审查。

docs/zh-CN/releasing.html.title: 发布 SOP | Fizzy.ImageViewer
docs/zh-CN/releasing.html.summary: 发布 SOP English 适用于 v1.2.0 及以后，不补档旧版。NuGet 有效载荷、不可变 /v{version}/r0/ 文档、版本索引和 GitHub Release 一致才算完成。禁止移动已发布 tag 或覆盖历史版本。NuGet 和 Pages 是独立服务，部分发布可以恢复，但不是原子事务。 一次性配置 GitHub Settings → Pages 选择 GitHub Actions。github-pages environment 允许 main 和发布 tag；发布任务在 tag 上执行。审批按仓库策略设置。 NuGet Trusted Publishing 配置 owner 0xfizzy、仓库 Fizzy.ImageViewer、工作流 release.yml；策略需要环境时设为 github-pages。仓库变量 NUGET_USER 保存用户名，不保存长期 API key。 发布任务需要 contents: write、pages: write、id-token: write；PR 和巡检只读。保护 main、发布 tag 和 docs-archive，允许发布机器人追加归档提交，禁止强推和删除。环境 tag 策略必须匹配工作流。 获得授权的维护者执行 docs/zh-CN/snapshots.html.title: 快照 | Fizzy.ImageViewer
docs/zh-CN/snapshots.html.summary: 快照 English CaptureSnapshotAsync 捕获已提交图像，而不是最新提交请求。整帧和区域重载返回独立拥有像素的 ImageSnapshot，使用后必须释放。 捕获与保存 Raw 保留原始值，必须使用 TIFF。Display 应用捕获时已提交的映射，支持 TIFF、PNG、JPEG、BMP；JPEG 将透明部分合成到黑色背景。绘图、测量标签和 HUD 不属于图像像素。 using var snapshot = await viewer.CaptureSnapshotAsync(SnapshotKind.Display); await snapshot.SaveAsync(path, SnapshotEncoding.Png); 参见完整导出示例。 区域必须非空且完全在帧内。没有输入或容量已满时抛出 InvalidOperationException。每个 Viewer 最多接纳两个捕获，一次执行一个导出读取；容量拒绝发生在获取租约之前。接纳时同步固定目标，排队不会改用较新的帧。 所有权、取消与失败 已接纳捕获拥有关闭后完成所需的依赖，结果由调用方拥有。AcquirePixels() 返回独立租约，可越过快照和 Viewer 生命周期。像素使用区域局部坐标，Region 和 SourceFrame 保留原始来源。 取消不证明 native 工作已结束，操作负责安全清理。保存持有独立租约；操作和清理失败一起保留，且清理错误可能发生在文件替换成功后。重试前检查实际文件。 尚未提交或失败的显示范围变更不影响捕获映射。参见帧契约和菜单目标。

docs/zh-CN/validation.html.title: 验证 | Fizzy.ImageViewer
docs/zh-CN/validation.html.summary: 验证 English 使用 Windows、PowerShell 7 和固定 SDK，独立检出即可构建，不需要相机或机器人。共享库输出的命令串行执行。自动 WPF 测试使用隐藏窗口和注入边界，不证明物理显示、混合 DPI、远程桌面或真实 GPU 行为。 构建与测试 dotnet restore Fizzy.ImageViewer.csproj --locked-mode dotnet build Fizzy.ImageViewer.csproj -c Release --no-restore dotnet test tests/Fizzy.ImageViewer.Tests/Fizzy.ImageViewer.Tests.csproj -c Release ./scripts/Test-Samples.ps1 ./scripts/Test-Release.ps1 是库、工具、示例、文档和包的完整门禁，不发布。依赖和浏览器安装见文档维护。发布前检查包 README、XML 和固定版本 URL；只有干净且 tag 匹配的 release-mode 验证能创建可发布 bundle。 像素查询 格式、来源或查询变更运行像素源、帧元数据、scheduler、HUD 和快照测试，覆盖独立租约、区域局部坐标、不可变结果、不支持能力、订阅/几何失效、有界接纳、公平、取消和操作/清理双重失败。TIFF 读取验证使用仅测试依赖 LibTIFF，不以写入器自证。 测量所有权与交互 会话/生命周期变更运行测量、交互和层测试，覆盖独立激活、工厂重入及失败、结束上下文、预览清理、恰好一次会话释放、通知顺序、程序编辑、控制点越界、注册撤销、关闭后外部租约。删除不再支持的恢复行为时保留线程/资源安全验证。 架构边界 公共 API 对照 PublicApi.txt 审查签名、可空性及默认值，不能盲目更新。联合工作区 API/行为变化还需父约定要求的消费者 Source 构建及测试；纯 XML 不改变签名，也不授权无关运行时修改。 初始化/关闭检查原错误、部分组合清理、共享终止失败、不重复破坏性释放、native 隔离和实际 STA 退出。菜单覆盖 Closed-before-Click、重新打开、撤销、独立动作资源和异步失败。 线剖面分配 热路径变化运行相关基准；合成结果不等于物理呈现或持续设备性能。 dotnet run --project tools/FrameBenchmark -c Release -- artifacts/frame-benchmark.json dotnet run --project tools/FrameBenchmark -c Release -- --snapshots artifacts/snapshot-copy-benchmark.json dotnet run --project tools/DrawingBenchmark -c Release dotnet run --project tools/ResizeBenchmark -c Release dotnet run --project tools/LineProfileBenchmark -c Release dotnet run --project tools/LineProfileBenchmark -c Release -- --query-publication 帧/快照报告耗时和托管分配，不是进程峰值内存。绘制排除消费者结果构造、跨线程和物理呈现；线剖面区分数据、WPF 命令、离屏呈现和查询复制，不可变结果所有权必须保留。 工具会话与图层所有权 覆盖单项/集合/空内容替换、Visual 和点击身份、失败保留旧内容、整层清理、重入和句柄失效，确认清业务层不清 HUD。取消/释放失败不应终止替代会话；几何/查询保留半开像素覆盖、极大有限坐标及非有限样本断点验证。 人工检查 运行三个示例，记录系统、缩放、显示器布局和 commit。检查首次显示、叠加上滚轮/中键、工具启动/取消、选择/编辑/删除、层隐藏、曲线关闭、HUD、菜单导出、实时流中关窗。按支持范围重复 DPI 变化和远程桌面。真实 GPU 附加/切换及设备需要另外授权的环境，明确报告未执行场景。 检查双语页面、搜索、项目路径下嵌套 API 和版本选择。发布/恢复还需发布 SOP、故障门禁及隔离服务演练；本地测试不授权正式发布。
